title: Shattered Red Enigma
description: A pale-skinned woman with long red hair lies on her side atop a bed of broken red glass shards, her body wrapped in a glossy, fragmented red bodysuit and long red gloves. Thick red liquid drips heavily from above, coating her skin, hair, and the surrounding shards against a dark, fiery red and black background.
